title: Convergence V1-V3: pin the never-land-a-CRITICAL invariant in the suite and align the once-only judge raise
routed_reason: the convergence package is console-built (ADR-0126 plan V1-V12); these are the round-2 verify check's filed items
source: console, 2026-10-07 convergence V1-V3 landing (round-2 verify-only check: MERGE, 0 blocking; F1 adopted at landing as TestKeepBest_FewerStrictFindingsOutrankALighterResidue)
summary: The round-2 check confirmed the landed-round CRITICAL guard (internal/convergence/decide.go landing) is unreachable today and recommended keeping it: the invariant rests on exempted never exempting a CRITICAL (pinned) and on keepBest's rank order (pinned at landing by a single example). The only thing that exercises the invariant across inputs is a 20,000-input sweep that lives outside the repo. Two smaller items: the M3 fix also limits the judge raise to the first rung-1 round, which spec section 3 row 2 and ADR-0126 decision 2 state only for the fixer (no effect at the default max_fix_rounds 3); and the guard's Stop, if it ever fired, would name the next rung's cause.
fix: Add a fixed-seed fast-tier property test (2-5k generated inputs through convergence.Decide) asserting, for every Land, Split and AcceptWithLimits: the landed round holds no unresolved CRITICAL; no decision defers an unresolved CRITICAL of its reference round; the landed round holds no unresolved finding at the decision's bar outside the split component, Defer and File. Align spec section 3 row 2 and ADR-0126 decision 2 with the code: the feedback change (fixer and judge raise) is made once, because a second raise has no headroom once the first moved to the top pair. Give the guard's Stop its own cause.
acceptance: The property test kills a keepBest rank-order swap (mass first) and the removal of the CRITICAL clause in exempted, each run as an overlay mutant
Spec, ADR and internal-convergence.md state one rule for the once-only raise, and a test pins it at max_fix_rounds 4
The suite stays under the fast tier's time budget
